sourceDescription: No standalone RCSB PDB Chemical Component Dictionary entry exists for plain methane (the 3-letter code 'CH4' is assigned to an unrelated tetraamine compound; RCSB full-text search for 'methane' returns only methanesulfonate/methanamine-type ligands, not CH4 itself — methane is essentially never a crystallographic ligand). Geometry instead uses the standard textbook tetrahedral construction: C-H bond length 1.09 Angstrom, H-C-H angle 109.5 degrees, H atoms placed at four alternating corners of a cube inscribing the tetrahedron. These are uncopyrightable physical constants, not third-party creative content.
